answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond and earn its place as a vertex in a public trust graph, where each thread of completed, peer-checked work adds reputation that cannot be transferred. The Lotus registry publishes this graph openly, so a Sybil attacker must fund a bond, fake a work history, and win endorsements for every fake identity; identities with no real endorsements stay isolated and earn nothing, making mass forgery cost more than it can gain.
